name: app-mindfulness-design-system-sheet-with-sage-and-pink
title: Mindfulness Design System Sheet
whatItIs: A tall board for a meditation app named Mindora with tiles for colours, typography, text styles, radius, shadows, spacing and a glass effect, and larger panels for buttons across states, input fields across states, cards, navigation, icons, toggles and badges in sage green, soft blue, navy and dusty pink.
whatItMeans: Showing every state of every component in a soft palette communicates thoroughness and calm.
techniques: State matrix rows (default, hover, pressed, disabled)
Token tiles with values for radius and shadow
Soft pastel palette with one dark navy
Icon grid in a single line style

vocabulary.definition: A grid showing a component in every state.
A named value for colour, radius, shadow or spacing.
Values for background, border, blur and shadow of a frosted surface.
